Beautiful view (outside), abysmal service inside. A terrible 41st birthday experience.
Sep 2026 • Friends
This was meant to be a celebratory dinner for my wife's 41st birthday. Instead, it was a letdown. I've lived in Saigon off and on since 2011, and this is among the worst experiences I've had in recent memory.

Let's be honest: you are paying for a beautiful river view and nothing else. The art on the walls tries to suggest elegance, but the indoor lighting is dull compared to the view outside.

Service was slow. Our main dish took over an hour to arrive, and given the high prices, we expected more than tiny portions of mediocre food.

When I asked to speak with the manager about the delay, they offered us dancing as a consolation. Yes, dancing. Because nothing says "sorry for the wait" like a little shuffle while you're still hungry.

The staff started off polite, but when we mentioned the passion fruit soda was way too sweet, they argued it wasn't sweet at all. Keep in mind – we never asked for less sugar. We just pointed it out. It already had a ton and was almost undrinkable.

Portions are tiny by Vietnamese standards. My family is planning to go to a nearby restaurant to eat properly because no one here has had enough – and this is while I'm writing this review, still waiting, still hungry, and still staring at a bill twice what we should have paid.

You have been warned.
